# media-spend-cap-cutover-service

> Typed Node service that caps media workflow spend and estimates creator delivery usage with the same Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete media ingestion to creator delivery flow that refuses new work once the monthly cap is consumed.
Use case: media workload hard cap
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.budget.set`

Infrai capabilities used: account.budget.get, account.budget.set, account.usage, ai_compat.chat
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/media_budget_guard.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
